_description: Device profile — physical-machine settings (safety envelope, motor feedrates, axis direction, axis mapping, stepper calibration). Edit on Hardware Setup → Device. Reusable across any experiment-level HardwareConfig.
notes: Reasonable defaults for a typical Prior ProScan + Marlin bioprinter. Generous safety envelope; medium feedrates. Axis map: Z=X, P1=Y, P2=Z (inverted), P3=E.
